title: Seed to Seedling | Germination Science
required_audio: Recorded real human narration only. No synthesized voice.
disclosure: Label scientific diagrams as illustrations. Do not depict generated macros as actual microscopy.
workflow: Footage license and provenance -> science review -> human narration -> captions -> phone QA -> release gate -> Metricool

scenes.name: Seed anatomy
scenes.visual: True macro seed image with scale and a separate clearly labeled botanical cross-section diagram
scenes.voice: A seed contains an embryo and stored resources, protected by its outer coat.
scenes.proof: Authentic seed photo or recorded footage; reviewed scientific diagram
scenes.avoid: Do not imply every seed has identical structures or dormancy.

scenes.name: Water uptake
scenes.visual: Macro moist seed and labeled schematic showing imbibition, not fabricated microscopy
scenes.voice: With suitable conditions, a viable seed absorbs water and resumes metabolic activity.
scenes.proof: Documented real seed imagery and reviewed illustration
scenes.avoid: Do not state that water alone guarantees germination.

scenes.name: Oxygen and respiration
scenes.visual: Real seed in aerated medium and diagram of oxygen exchange
scenes.voice: Oxygen supports respiration as the embryo begins growing.
scenes.proof: Authentic camera footage and reference-backed oxygen schematic
scenes.avoid: Do not show bubbles as if they are directly filmed cellular oxygen.

scenes.name: Radicle emergence
scenes.visual: Authentic close-up time-lapse or sequential real photographs of radicle breaking through seed coat
scenes.voice: The embryonic root, called the radicle, is usually the first visible structure to emerge.
scenes.proof: Source-verified early radicle footage, with consistent specimen timeline
scenes.avoid: Never substitute a flower or full plant for radicle emergence.

scenes.name: Shoot emergence
scenes.visual: Real emergence footage with anatomically checked emergence labels
scenes.voice: The developing shoot rises as the seedling establishes its first leaves.
scenes.avoid: Do not show mature true leaves before cotyledon emergence.

scenes.name: Seedling and observations
scenes.visual: Young seedling full view, real cotyledon and true-leaf closeups, simple observation log
scenes.voice: Observe the cotyledons, then the first true leaves. Record timing and conditions rather than guessing.
scenes.proof: Real seedling photography, checked labels and sources
scenes.avoid: Do not imply identical timing across species or environments.
